prose: Bloomberg reports Alphabet has disclosed more than $1 trillion in purchase commitments, future leases and other obligations, with its Q3 filing showing $98.5 billion in contingent commitments - up roughly $23 billion from Q2. The company points to rapid growth in its backlog of unfulfilled cloud contracts as evidence of demand.
highlights: Alphabet discloses $1T+ in purchase commitments, leases and other obligations
Contingent commitments of $98.5B in the Q3 filing, up ~$23B from Q2
Company cites fast-growing unfulfilled cloud contract backlog
